G3_raw_HVS_SEAAD_source_asset_identity_a.interpretation: All 24 HVS and 11 SEA-AD raw H5ADs were hash-bound before count read. The corrected join is physical var identifier -> frozen provenance exact Ensembl ID -> molecular address; positional source_feature_index is not used. G1b later verified the corrected values under that identity policy. This is inherited implementation/source authority, not TD outcome authority.

G4_TD_specific_9216_address_one_to_one_c.rule: Every one of the exact 9,216 frozen TD addresses must resolve to exactly one non-collision physical column in every required HVS/SEA-AD matrix. No replacement address is permitted.

G5_exact_sample_A_cell_resolution_in_raw.rule: For each Sample-A HVS/SEA-AD row, raw obs[local_row] must equal the frozen cell_id exactly.

G6_sample_A_library_and_detected_count_v.rule: Before normalized TD values are accepted, recomputed whole-cell raw library size and detected-feature count must equal the preserved TD metadata sentinels for every Sample-A cell.

G7_cross_check_against_existing_S174_val.rule: Where the Sample-A read overlaps an already checked S174 matrix/address condition, corrected physical-ID reads must agree. No new tolerance may be invented.
